Curriculum

Six Modules. One Day. Zero Gaps.

Each module builds directly on the last. By module 6 you'll have a complete, shippable prototype — not a demo, not a mockup.

MOD / 01
⬡
Figma to Claude Code

Screenshot your Figma frames. Feed them directly to Claude Code. Watch it generate production-ready HTML + CSS components in seconds. You'll understand the prompt structure that gets it right first try.

Core Skill Figma Claude Code Screenshot-to-Code
MOD / 02
⌘
Local Setup & Direct Prompting

Set up your local file structure the right way. Learn to prompt directly from within Claude Code's context — referencing your files, your components, your token system — for outputs that actually fit your project.

Setup File Structure Context Prompting
MOD / 03
◎
One-Shot & Fine-Tune

The art of the one-shot prompt. How to load enough context that Claude nails it first pass — and when it doesn't, the exact correction loop that preserves your design intent while iterating fast.

Power Move Prompt Craft Iteration
MOD / 04
▣
Design System Architecture

Build it structurally: Style Kit → Tokens → Base Components → Composite Components → Full Screens with interactions. The same system senior engineers use, built in a fraction of the time.

Core Skill Design System Tokens Interactions
MOD / 05
↑
Ship It with HTMLPub

One command. Your prototype goes live. No Vercel setup. No deployment drama. Connect your Claude Code workflow to HTMLPub's MCP server and share a real URL with stakeholders before lunch is over.

Ship It HTMLPub MCP Live URL
MOD / 06
⟳
Framework Handoff

Convert your prototype to whatever framework developers actually need — React, Vue, Svelte. No rewriting from scratch. You become the designer who can hand off production-ready code, not just specs.

Final Boss React Vue Dev Handoff

From Zero to

Setup & Foundations
